neighbours.label: 'Time to' saying that the moment has come for an action, firing on ' to', ' for', ' de' after 'time', 'temps', 'hora', 'momento'; 'de' and 'to' in other frames stay quiet.

Now is the time to invest.

Es el hermano de mi amigo.
